Hi Zoe —

Thanks for applying and for the quick note. I’d love to set up a 30‑minute intro phone screen to learn more about your background and walk through the role. I know you’re based in Auckland (NZST) per your resume — below are a few slots that would work on our side; I’ve listed them in your local time to make this easier: 

• Wednesday, Aug 12 — 9:30–10:00 PM NZST
• Thursday, Aug 13 — 8:00–8:30 AM NZST
• Thursday, Aug 13 — 10:00–10:30 PM NZST

If any of these work, reply with the slot you prefer and whether you prefer phone or Google Meet. I’ll send an invite once we confirm. If none of those are possible, tell me two windows (30m) in NZST that work and I’ll match them.

Also, if you can reattach the most recent resume (I only had a brief preview), that would be helpful.

Looking forward —
